# Contributing to the OpenLancer engine

This repository is the engine fork of OpenLancer. It is not Librelancer.

- Report problems with this fork at https://github.com/spool1/openlancer/issues. Do not report them to Librelancer.
- Each change to this fork is a commit on the branch `openlancer`. Its subject starts with its change number, for example `OL-0012`. See `docs/UPSTREAM.md` in the OpenLancer repository.
- Do not send changes from this fork to Librelancer. Librelancer does not accept AI-written issues or pull requests.
- Code must be available under the MIT License, as the rest of this repository is.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` in the repository root is the upstream Librelancer guide. It applies to contributions to Librelancer, not to this fork.
